findings.evidence: JS_malloc buffer is used by fill_n/BN_bn2bin before any null check; current callers check only after return.
findings.impact: A failed nonempty allocation can reach a null-derived write rather than the intended clean failure. No fault was induced.
findings.nextCut: Check allocation/empty-size contract before pointer arithmetic, padding or BN export; preserve existing failure result/error ordering.

findings.evidence: Five groups/15 get_bn_param calls write raw outputs before later RAII adoption. Short-circuit failure, especially optional CRT fallback, returns with earlier successful outputs unowned.
findings.api: OpenSSL p_lib.c2154-2200 calls OSSL_PARAM_get_BN; params.c921-935 calls BN_native2bn and transfers successful allocation through *val.
findings.impact: Source-visible leak on partial extraction. Whether a provider/input/allocation reaches a particular failure was not tested.
findings.nextCut: Sequential helper acquires output into BignumPtr immediately after each call, before status branching; preserve original short-circuit/fallback semantics and every acquired owner across fallback.

findings.kind: successful EC point buffer has no owner
findings.evidence: pub_key allocated by EC_POINT_point2buf is used by param builder but never freed on success or subsequent failure paths.
findings.api: OpenSSL ec_oct.c137-157 OPENSSL_malloc allocates and assigns *pbuf on success; param_build.c274 onward stores the pointer until conversion.
findings.impact: Repeated successful EC key reconstruction retains an otherwise lost native public-point allocation; no runtime leak measurement was run.
findings.nextCut: Add actual OPENSSL_free functor/unique owner and adopt pub_key immediately; keep it alive through OSSL_PARAM_BLD_to_param and all later failures.

findings.evidence: HMAC bytes*8 uses size_t, optional JS Number is assigned to unsigned long without finite/range conversion, new_mac_key takes int, BN_bin2bn takes int, DER length is long. Bare vector/new allocation is compiled with -fno-exceptions; if(!data) does not establish recoverable vector allocation failure.
findings.impact: Bit-length wrap or narrowing can alter native length interpretation beyond bounds; large-input reachability and observable error parity are not established here.
findings.nextCut: Separate checked size-to-bit and size-to-int/long helpers before copies/library calls, explicit numeric conversion policy and fallible owner allocation choice. Do not invent broad input caps or change errors without source/API review.

findings.kind: secret copies outside current logical-byte wiping
findings.evidence: Decoded HMAC JWK data_string, EC/RSA private component strings, private byte exports and BIGNUM temporaries use ordinary storage/deleters. BN_free does not select BN_clear_free; normal OSSL_PARAM_free calls OPENSSL_free for ordinary param storage.
findings.impact: Existing SecretByteVectorDeleter covers logical vector bytes and sensitive CopiedBufferSource covers owned raw copies; no all-copies erasure proof follows.
findings.nextCut: Separate audited secret-buffer/string/BN ownership policy with lengths and partial-failure cleanup; verify param-storage ownership and preserve no-all-copies/no-finalizer-wipe claims.
